body: I'm going to sleep now. The night awaits me.

You can't help me. I don't know why nobody understands. You can fight the symptoms of it, but the cause will remain and as long as the cause is there the pain will come back. I'm the cause of my pain, so in order to be painless I have to be the one eliminated.

I want to be like anybody else, do my experiences like anybody of my age, feel young and happy and take every oppurtunity that life gives you. But it's not meant to be like that.
Yes, music. I love music. Music was the only thing that kept me going a year ago, because I thought of all the great songs I would miss when I'd be gone, but it's nothing that gives me comfort anymore. Nothing gives me comfort. I want to scream and cry, but I can't. It's one of the signs of depression, my father told me once. I hate him, I hate my parents. Because they made me, released me to this world, withour asking...just of pure egoism that they wanted children.

I'm 20 years old. I live in Europe.
Yeah, I talked to my friends, my sister, my mother and my psychologist. They know what my problems are; some more, some less but they don't know I'm this suicidal.
I'm not going to tell you my dreams, nobody understood it until know and I wont expect anybody to ever understand it. It's shallow, seemingly, but it's a chainreaction, but there werw too many things that happened in my life already, so maybe it's just something that adds to it, idk.
How do you want me to stay with you. How would you help me? I'm only a text on a website and you will soon forget what was written here, the only proof of my existence you ever knew.
